{{Quote|New Republic transport, prepare to be boarded! Your hyperdrive will not operate while under the influence of our gravity-well projectors. If you cooperate, this will be over quickly and painlessly.|A Lumini pirate aboard their Interdictor cruiser, to a New Republic corvette|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
The [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini pirates']] '''Interdictor cruiser''' was used in supply raids and held [[starship]]s captive with its [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]]. To complement the stolen [[Interdictor-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Interdictor]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]], the [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] stored [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] like the [[R60 T-wing interceptor]], [[R-41 Starchaser]]s, [[Z-95-AF4 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], and [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wings]] in its [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]].<ref name="MOTS" />

In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening scrawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> the Lumini pirates, deployed their Interdictor in a [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|raid]] on a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]]. The cruiser's gravity wells held the corvette in [[Realspace/Legends|realspace]] while a raiding party from their [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|Nebulon-B frigate]] boarded the ship and began moving supplies through a docking tube. Unbeknownst to the pirates, a secret part of the cargo, a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]], was guarded by Jedi [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. Jade followed the stolen cargo aboard the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in a crate, and stowed away when the cruiser, frigate, and other pirate ships [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumped]] to the pirates' [[Orbiting Ship Yards]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MOTSManualInterdictorCruiser.png|thumb|right|200px|The Interdictor cruiser from the game manual]]
{{Quote|Mara's next mission took place aboard a New Republic Corellian corvette. The designer Steve Hwang actually took a schematic and laid the mission out EXACTLY conforming to shape and space of the corvette. There's no faking on this one.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The Lumini pirates' Interdictor cruiser appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Designer [[Stephen Hwang]] laid out the game level where the Interdictor appeared onscreen.<ref name="Blog" />
